commands.description: Main CLI group – dispatches to all subcommands
Submit and monitor a PBS job (conda, module, singularity, or default context)
Launch an interactive PBS session
Configuration management (get/set, shortcuts, aliases, files, validate)
Create or update a reusable execution shortcut
List all configured shortcuts
Show details of a specific shortcut
Delete a shortcut
Cancel PBS jobs by ID or name pattern
Query and display job status
View computational recipes and execution records
Monitor multiple PBS jobs simultaneously
Send Slack/Discord notifications on job completion
Replay recorded interactive session transcripts
View resource usage and efficiency statistics
Platform discovery, info, and queue listing
Select best queue for given resources
Validate resource specifications against platform
Estimate job cost in service units
Legacy alias management (deprecated; use config alias)

modules.description: Package root – version, lazy CLI import, public API re-exports
Main Click group; registers all subcommands
Job execution command – parses ~45 options, resolves shortcuts, dispatches to execution contexts
Interactive PBS session launcher with shell and env support
Configuration management CLI – get/set/list/files/validate plus shortcut and alias subgroups
Cancel jobs by ID, name, or pattern with resource-tracker integration
Job status queries – list recent, show details, summary
History CLI – recipes, executions, latest, out, err, log
Multi-job monitoring with real-time status display
Notification CLI – send and test Slack/Discord hooks
Replay interactive session recordings with timing
Resource-tracking CLI – list, show, CSV export, tag/date filtering
Platform management CLI – list, info, queues
Legacy alias CLI (deprecated; code moved to config_cli)
Shortcut resolution – loads system/user shortcuts JSON, finds longest-match
Legacy execution context module (functionality moved to execution/)
Hierarchical config loading/merging (Override > Test > Local > Project > User > System > Defaults)
Job option processing – apply defaults, sanitize job name, resolve output dir
Shortcut loading/resolution with system/user JSON files
Standalone entry-point aliases: qx_main, qxet_main, qxtat_main
Execution package public API – re-exports from context, mode, submit
ExecutionContext (validate, template, job_env) and execute_unified, the qxub exec path
Detect LOCAL vs REMOTE vs REMOTE_DELEGATED execution mode from platform config
dispatch (the one submission pipeline) and submit_job, the programmatic API
SchedulerBackend interface, JobSpec, LiveJob, SubmitError, SchedulerQueryError
LocalBackend – jobs as background processes on this machine (platform type: local)
PbsBackend – every qsub/qstat/qdel call, the qstat output parsers, and -l parsing/rendering of ResourceSpec
get_backend(): the platform definition's type picks the scheduler backend
Monitoring and status files – qdel, monitor_job_single_thread, job_status_from_files, get_job_resource_data (scheduler calls go through qxub/backends)
Job script template loading – get_template, get_conda_template, etc.
Platform abstraction – Platform, Queue, QueueLimits, QueueSelector, detect_platform
Platform CLI subcommands – estimate_cmd, validate_cmd, select_queue_cmd
Parse PBS resource formats – size_to_bytes, time_to_seconds, parse_exec_host, parse_joblog_resources
Resource utilities – parse/format memory and walltime, evaluate queue constraints
ResourceSpec – scheduler-neutral resource request (cpus, memory, walltime, gpus, disk, native); the one size and duration parser
SQLite-based job resource tracking and efficiency analysis
SQLite queue DB – virtual IDs, job entries, status updates, bulk queries
Dual-log history system – one JSON file per recipe/execution under ~/.config/qxub/history
SSH-based remote job execution using platform config
Serialize qxub commands for SSH execution
Slack webhook notifier
Discord webhook notifier
